reviews.title: Will charge you for the “free” subscription and doesn’t work as advertised
reviews.text: I am not one to usually write bad reviews but this app was just terrible. When opening the app it is shown that you are able to play music on multiple speakers but need a subscription. I saw that it said “Try free for 3 days then subscription for ~$9.99”. I was already annoyed that you need a subscription to use the app but then on top of that you can’t use any outside music apps. So after that I was like yeah I don’t want to use it anymore (unsubscribed right away). But they had the audacity to still charge me for the ~$9.99 subscription even though I cancelled it day one. Overall VERY disappointing, not only did the app not work as advertised but also had the audacity to charge me for a subscription I never used. Worst app I’ve ever used.
